decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk builds directly on the firm's office furniture know-how and in-house R&D, so management can read early market signals and refine the product, which supports keeping it.
A chair family sits at the core of the firm's craftsmanship and upholstery expertise, so the firm can absorb customer feedback and improve the line easily.

Floor cushions made from carpets extend the firm's material expertise, but they are a niche accessory with uncertain returns; still, the firm has enough related knowledge to keep developing them for now.
The soft upholstered sofa is close to the firm's established living range, though its weak website presence suggests modest priority, so the firm keeps it for now and watches the results.
The high standing table complements the firm's conference and office systems and draws on existing construction knowledge, which makes it easy to assess and improve.

The rug collection is distant from the firm's furniture know-how, which limits its ability to interpret results and improve the product, but it was only launched in 2018 and is still prominently presented, so dropping it within a year is less likely than keeping it.
